src: tools/blender/neighbourhood_shop (export_shop.py: the owner's GLBs as FBX in studs; publish.py: the upload).
placement: InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId):GetChildren()[1] is a Model whose pivot is the FBX origin = the centre of the shop floor; PivotTo(the venue's pivot) puts every MeshPart at its `centre` (venue frame at yaw 0). Each MeshPart is unrotated. Untextured materials may arrive grey: Server/Assets/ShopArt paints a MeshPart without a SurfaceAppearance with its `colour`; `alpha` < 1 is glass.

superseded.why: the first roof upload, its colours on the vertices; replaced by the roof with its colours in its materials

units: studs; the venue frame at yaw 0 (X across, Y up, Z = -D), origin at the centre of the shop floor

roof.turn: -90 degrees about the vertical (ridge along X, chimney at +Z)
